mapper.sql: select id, binding_id, title, body, status, opens_at, closes_at, published_by_user_id, created_by_user_id, created_at from edu_course_announcement
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_announcement (binding_id, title, body, status, opens_at, closes_at, published_by_user_id, created_by_user_id, created_at) values (#{bindingId}, #{title}, #{body}, 'DRAFT', #{opensAt}, #{closesAt}, null, #{createdByUserId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update edu_course_announcement set status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by_user_id = #{publishedByUserId}, opens_at = coalesce(opens_at, #{now}) where id = #{id} and binding_id = #{bindingId} and status = 'DRAFT' and published_by_user_id is null
